t: Introduction and overview — Wasp-class Amphibious Assault Ship
name: Introduction and overview — Wasp-class Amphibious Assault Ship — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Wasp-class Amphibious Assault Ship
description: Introduction and overview of the Wasp-class Amphibious Assault Ship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Wasp class — eight ships — are 41,150-ton amphibious assault ships (LHD) that operate AV-8B Harriers, F-35Bs, and helicopters alongside landing craft and 1,600+ Marines. They are the centerpiece of U.S. expeditionary strike groups; Bonhomme Richard was lost to fire in 2020. Baseline facts: U.S. amphibious assault ship; 8 built; 41,150 tons; Harriers/F-35B + Marines..
